'''Operation: Etching Wheel''' was a clandestine operation conducted by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]'s [[Mid Rim Operations Group]] under the command of [[Ardun Kothe]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
